#性质名称f(t)F(ω)
1唯一性f(t)F(ω)
2线性\sum_{i=1}^{n}A_i f_i(t) A_i为常数, n为正整数\sum_{i=1}^{n}A_i F_i(\omega)
3对称性F(t)2 \pi f(-\omega)
4奇偶虚实性f*(t)F*(-ω)
fe(t)Re[f(ω)]
fo(t)jIm[f(ω)]
5尺度变换特性f(at)(a为非零实常数)\frac{1}{|a|} F\left(\frac{\omega}{a}\right)
f(-t)F(-ω)
6时移性f(t-t0)(t0为实常数)F(ω)e- jωt0
f(at-t0)(a, t0为实常数)\frac{1}{|a|} F\left(\frac{\omega}{a}\right)e^{-j\frac{\omega}{a} t_0}
7频移f(t)e±jω0t(ω0为实常数)F(ω≠ω0)
f(t)cos(ω0t)\frac{1}{2}[F(\omega + \omega_0) + F(\omega - \omega_0)]
f(t)sin(ω0t)\frac{j}{2}[F(\omega + \omega_0) - F(\omega - \omega_0)]
8时域微分要求:\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}f(t)dt<\infty否则不能用\frac{df(t)}{dt}jωF(ω)
\frac{d^k f(t)}{dt^k}(jω)kF(ω)
